threads.body: @trask should this be required to implement?

replies.body:
yeah, makes sense

@walleseve probably we should take care of AWS Bedrock streaming cases at the same time, since otherwise this will start emitting streaming `false` incorrectly for them

Good call. I made `isRequestStreaming(...)` required and implemented it explicitly for OpenAI chat, OpenAI embeddings (`false`), and AWS Bedrock. Bedrock now detects `ConverseStreamRequest` and `InvokeModelWithResponseStreamRequest`; its library and javaagent suites assert `true` for streaming paths, while non-streaming requests continue to omit the attribute. Since this changes the incubating getter contract, I also documented it as a non-stable API break.

threads.body: feels like a bit of an overkill, instead could have tested that extractor emits the streaming arg in onStart phase similarly to what `HttpClientAttributesExtractorTest` and `MessagingAttributesExtractorTest` do

replies.body: Agreed. I removed the custom sampler integration test and added `GenAiAttributesExtractorTest`, which calls `onStart(...)` directly and verifies that streaming emits `gen_ai.request.stream=true` while non-streaming omits the attribute.

threads.body: could have convenience methods `create` and `createStreaming` and perhaps skip the builder altogether

replies.body: Agreed. I removed the builder and replaced it with `ChatCompletionRequest.create(...)` and `createStreaming(...)`, then updated the synchronous and asynchronous call sites and tests.
